reviewer: Codex primary final critical reading; selected separate-reader findings retained in evidence/reviews. No human/Claude acceptance claimed.

clarity.evidence: One question explains request creation, invocation, response text and token metadata before introducing other result modes.

scope.evidence: Runnable MVC endpoints cover answer, structured card and stream using offline fixtures with explicit response modes.

contracts.evidence: One ChatResponse supplies text and usage; unknown usage stays unknown; call-spec creation is distinguished from terminal invocation.

correctness.evidence: 19 actual JUnit tests and six loopback HTTP checks pass against the pinned 1.1.8 baseline, without model-provider calls.

failure_handling.evidence: Malformed/invalid entities fail, completed empty streams fail, and each stream subscription creates a fresh spec; idle and total deadlines are distinguished.

tradeoffs.evidence: ChatClient versus model, buffering versus streaming and deterministic fixture tests versus live provider/model evaluation are answered.

visual_learning.evidence: The Java-emitted timeline contrasts construction/invocation and successful/failed conversion; the player makes no live provider request.

code.evidence: examples/learning-spring-ai; full copyable source/download parity and exact excerpts checked by check_review_lot.py; actual runtime output in lot-command-output.json and lot-runtime.json.

rendering.evidence: AI-7-browser.json: article and walkthrough in light/dark at 1280/390px; theme controls, navigation, no missing images/page-wide overflow, table contrast >=4.5. Per-topic assets resolve.

limits: Local mechanism and fixture checks do not establish remote-provider behavior, distributed durability/failover, production throughput or model quality. Scope-specific boundaries are explicit in the answer.
